title: Grilled Chicken Yakitori
description: Japanese-style grilled chicken skewers, perfect for a quick meal or appetizer.
instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and thread onto skewers.
In a small bowl, whisk together ga, pho, and vinegar to make the marinade.
Add the chicken to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Brush the skewers with sesame oil and grill for 5-7 minutes per side.
While the chicken is cooking, mix together soy sauce and sugar in a small bowl.
Brush the skewers with the soy sauce mixture during the last minute of cooking.
Serve the chicken hot with norito wrappers on the side.
To assemble, place a piece of chicken onto a norito wrapper, add some sliced scallions and serve.
